details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh:5-10 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the codex_run_budget_* helper family without providing a replacement implementation.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently report that the reviewers/editor still call these helpers, so the soft-deadline budget contract now fail-opens at runtime.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:3564-3640 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: reviewer_budget_may_continue() now falls back to an unset JOB_DEADLINE and then to a hardcoded 7620-second allowance.
  WHY: That fallback is more permissive than the intended soft deadline, so reviewer slots keep running instead of being skipped; reviewers split on BLOCKER vs MAJOR, so BLOCKER is the highest severity.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1657-1706 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The editor budget check uses JOB_TIMEOUT_SECS=10800 as its fallback anchor when the shared budget helper is unavailable.
  WHY: That hard job cap is about 30 minutes shorter than the 210-minute soft deadline, so partial-finalize can trigger too early.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4048-4238 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The partial-finalize early-exit path returns before REVIEWER_CONSENSUS_FILE is produced.
  WHY: Downstream consolidation and resume consumers expect that file, so exiting 0 without writing it breaks the partial-completion contract.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:119-148, 4104-4238 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: REVIEWER_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUEST_FILE is created but not cleaned up when the script exits early.
  WHY: A stale marker makes the next run think partial finalize was already requested and can cause immediate premature exit on later runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5294-5462 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The partial-finalize comment/marker step is gated by success(), so it is skipped whenever an earlier step fails.
  WHY: That means a recoverable partial-but-landed run can still end red instead of switching to the finalize path; reviewers split on BLOCKER vs MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4037-4968 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The commit and push steps are both guarded by AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED != 'true', so validated edits are skipped during partial finalize.
  WHY: That blocks the required commit/push of already-validated autofix edits; reviewers agreed this is a blocker.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:627-645 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: request_editor_partial_finalize() relies on GITHUB_ENV without robustly handling missing or unwritable env-file writes.
  WHY: If the write fails, later workflow steps will not see AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED and the editor can continue past the intended stop.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:2286-2359 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The recoverable-failure editor fallback still writes the old generic summary text instead of the partial-finalize-aware summary.
  WHY: Downstream consumers that read EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE get misleading content about the run state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5290-5462, 6392-6595 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The partial-finalize path does not consistently carry REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL and ledger state through skipped_budget runs.
  WHY: Resume consumers can then observe stale or missing state even though the workflow posted the partial-finalize marker.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4054-4127 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The pass-status accounting does not clearly distinguish all-reviewers-skipped-for-budget from actual failures.
  WHY: That ambiguity makes the continuation versus partial-finalize transition unreliable.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:3531-3537 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer slot prefix toggles between "review" and "pass1" based on existing status files.
  WHY: It is only cosmetic, but the naming fallback is misleading.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:393-399 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: CODEX_HEARTBEAT no longer includes the budget_elapsed_secs and budget_remaining_secs suffix fields.
  WHY: Downstream parsers lose budget telemetry from a stable heartbeat contract; reviewers disagree on severity (NIT vs MAJOR), so MAJOR is the highest.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Teach review_autofix.yml to transition into a finalize path when the soft deadline is exhausted or a single phase fails in a recoverable/caught way."
  expected_change_site: scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh or a new shared helper file containing the codex_run_budget_* functions
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: codex_run_budget_* helpers were deleted from scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh and no replacement exists; callers in review_run_reviewers.sh and review_apply_fixes.sh fail open.
- requirement: "Finalization must commit and push any already-validated autofix edits"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml — the "Push all pending commits" step (line 4968) and the commit step at line 4037
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The commit and push steps are guarded by AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED != 'true', so validated edits are skipped during partial finalize.
- requirement: "Tests cover finalize-on-deadline and green-on-partial behavior."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py or tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The added tests are wiring/contract assertions only; no behavioral test exercises soft-deadline exhaustion, request_editor_partial_finalize, partial-finalize summary content, or a green partial outcome.
- requirement: "Update README additively under the existing review/autofix docs; document the partial-completion contract and non-failure exit semantics."
  expected_change_site: README.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: README updates mention partial finalize in high-level terms but do not document the partial_finalize.json schema/path, the PR comment format, or the explicit green-on-partial exit semantics.
- requirement: "The partial-finalize workflow must consistently carry reviewers-successful state through skipped_budget runs so resume consumers have correct state."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml partial-finalize step and summary emitter
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: The partial-finalize path posts the marker/comment but does not consistently persist REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL and ledger state for skipped-budget runs.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 5-10 (deletion of entire codex_run_budget_* family, ~178 lines removed)
  Problem: The PR removes every codex_run_budget_* helper function (codex_run_budget_initialize, codex_run_budget_export, codex_run_budget_remaining_secs, codex_run_budget_summary, codex_run_budget_phase_may_start, normalize_review_soft_deadline_minutes) from scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh and does not add them to any other file.
  Why it fails at runtime: Both scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh and scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh call these functions through command -v fail-open guards; the soft-deadline budget contract has no implementation.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 3589-3590
  Problem: reviewer_budget_may_continue() falls back to JOB_DEADLINE when codex_run_budget_remaining_secs is unavailable, but JOB_DEADLINE is never initialized in review_run_reviewers.sh.
  Why it fails at runtime: With codex_run_budget_* deleted, every reviewer slot invocation enters the else branch and uses the hardcoded 7620-second budget, so a reviewer slot that should be skipped at the soft deadline instead proceeds.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 1657-1658
  Problem: The editor fallback JOB_DEADLINE is computed as JOB_START_EPOCH + JOB_TIMEOUT_SECS where JOB_TIMEOUT_SECS=$((180 * 60)) = 10800 seconds.
  Why it fails at runtime: The soft deadline is 210 minutes, so the fallback is 30 minutes shorter than intended and can trigger partial finalize too early.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 4122, 4223, 4238 (early exit after pass1/pass2/single-pass partial-finalize)
  Problem: When reviewer_partial_finalize_requested returns true, the script exits 0 after writing REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL to GITHUB_ENV, but it does not produce REVIEWER_CONSENSUS_FILE.
  Why it fails at runtime: Downstream consolidation and resume consumers expect REVIEWER_CONSENSUS_FILE, so the missing file breaks the partial-completion contract.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 119, 4122, 4223, 4238 (REVIEWER_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUEST_FILE)
  Problem: REVIEWER_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUEST_FILE is created by reviewer_request_partial_finalize() but never cleaned up after the script exits.
  Why it fails at runtime: On the next workflow run for the same PR, reviewer_partial_finalize_requested() returns true immediately from the stale file and causes every subsequent run to exit early.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: line 5294
  Problem: The "Post partial finalize comment and persist runtime marker" step is gated with if: "success() && env.AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED == 'true' && ...".
  Why it fails at runtime: If any prior step fails, the partial-finalize step is skipped despite AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED being true, so the run ends red instead of transitioning to finalize.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
  Line or code reference: line 396 (was line 406
